subject: BrightLayer - vendor onboarding & payment-cycle harmonization
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightlayer.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightLayer - Vendor Onboarding & Payment Terms

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to start the onboarding so we can accept POs and begin delivering next month. A few items from our side:

- Attached: W9_BrightLayer.pdf and company bank details (separate file if you prefer).
- Our standard payment terms are Net 60.
- We can offer a 2% early-pay discount for Net 10 if Redwood can commit to an accelerated payment path for the first three invoices.

Can you send the vendor onboarding form your procurement team requires and confirm the PO flow (does Redwood require a PO for each invoice, and what is the PO lead time)? Also confirm the contact for AP wiring.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Finance Operations
BrightLayer Inc.
elena@brightlayer.com
Attachments: W9_BrightLayer.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer - Vendor Onboarding & Payment Terms

Hi Elena — great to get this started. Looping in Procurement (Marissa) and Finance (Karthik) to get vendor setup and payment cadence in motion. Outline below:

Onboarding checklist (what we need from BrightLayer):
- Completed Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form (attached).
- Completed W-9 (received).
- Bank details file or remittance instructions (received if you attach).
- Signed supplier agreement or acceptance via DocuSign (link below).

PO & payment process (how we operate):
- Redwood issues a PO for each engagement line item; PO must be returned signed within 5 business days to avoid scheduling delays.
- Standard payment term: Net 45 from invoice date.
- Payments processed via ACH; AP runs weekly payment files on Wednesdays.

Early pay evaluation:
- We can evaluate an early-pay pilot. Typical patterns: 1.5%–2% discount for payment within 7–10 days, subject to Finance approval. Karthik, can you advise if we can pilot 2% 10-day for first two invoices?

Next steps for BrightLayer: please complete and return the attached Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and sign the DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/brightlayer-onboard/ABCDEF123456. Once Finance confirms the early-pay structure we'll add the terms to the vendor record and create the first PO.

Happy to schedule a 30-minute sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf; DocuSign link

From: Elena Torres <elena@brightlayer.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Finance <ap@brightlayer.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer - Vendor Onboarding & Payment Terms

Hi Rachel / team,

Thanks — completed the onboarding form and e-signed via DocuSign (confirmation included). Attached is our bank details CSV for ACH enrollment.

On the early-pay request: BrightLayer can accept a 1.75% discount for payment within 7 days and would appreciate a pilot for the first two invoices. If Redwood prefers 2% for 10 days we can do that as well — flexible either way. Our preference is faster payment (7 days) for cashflow planning.

Let us know what Finance decides; we can turn the pilot on immediately once the vendor record is created and PO is issued.

Best regards,
Elena Torres
Head of Finance Operations
BrightLayer Inc.
elena@brightlayer.com
Attachments: BankDetails_BrightLayer.csv

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer - Vendor Onboarding & Payment Terms (PO / early-pay pilot)

Team — quick follow-up so we can close this out this week:

Summary:
- BrightLayer has returned the onboarding form and W-9, and provided bank details (attached).
- They request an early-pay pilot: 1.75% for payment within 7 days (or 2% / 10 days if preferred).
- Need Procurement to create vendor record & vendor code; Finance to approve early-pay parameters and configure payment-run exception for the pilot.

Requested actions:
- Marissa: please create the vendor code in Coupa/our vendor master, attach the onboarding artifacts, and confirm vendor ID back to thread. Also prepare PO template and mark as "early-pay pilot" in the remarks so AP sees the flag. (See attached PO_Template.pdf)
- Karthik: can you confirm whether Finance can support 1.75%/7d pilot for the first two invoices? If not, please advise the max discount you can authorize and whether you need Exec sign-off. If approved, please coordinate with AP to toggle the payment-run to include BrightLayer as an exception for the pilot.

I scheduled a 30-minute sync for Friday, 11/10 at 10:00 PT to confirm PO issuance and payment run details — invite to follow. If either of you want to triage earlier, ping me and I'll jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Rachel
Attachments: EarlyPayProposal_BrightLayer.xlsx; PO_Template.pdf
